newsitem.title: USA: MGM Grand files $600 mln debt, equity shelf.
newsitem.headline: MGM Grand files $600 mln debt, equity shelf.

text.p: MGM Grand Inc filed with regulators on Wednesday to offer up to $600 million in debt securities and common stock.

In a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Las Vegas-based entertainment, hotel and gaming company said proceeds from the offering will go toward general corporate purposes.

The company said those may include financing the development of new facilities, additions to working capital, debt reduction, capital expenditure financing, potential acquisitions and repurchases of the company's common stock.
